next.note: 32a, 38a and 32b are done (2026-11-10). 32c (out-of-hours Lists) is the last Schedule phase; the Contracts track (18 on) resumes after it.

guidance.headline: Start 32c now. The Contracts track follows it.
guidance.headline_sub: 32b (unavailability never a conflict, notices that resolve, alert the office) is done, after 32a and 38a. 32c builds the out-of-hours List on top of 32b's unavailability and move paths; the Contracts track (18 on) resumes after 32c, in the ROADMAP's run order.
guidance.parallel: Only 32c is next in the run order. 18 and 26 have their dependencies met but come later in the run order (see below), so run 32c on its own.

safe.32c: It has no open question: it builds D84's working design (provisional, kept in one module), so a later design decision is a contained change. Its dependencies (32b and 38a) are done.

wait.18: Its dependency (17) is done, but the run order puts the Contracts track after 32c; four of its questions are still open (OQ-73, OQ-114, OQ-133, OQ-135).
wait.26: Its dependency (17) is done, but the run order puts it after the Contracts track (18 to 25).
